errorCodes.meaning: The presentation is bound to a nonce the verifier no longer considers fresh.
The presentation is bound to a different audience than the verifier.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

KeyedVpToken.description: OID4VP 1.0 §8.1: each member name is the `id` of a credential query in the query's `dcql_query`, and its value the presentations answering it.

anyOf.description: An SD-JWT-VC presentation: the consented disclosures plus a mandatory key-binding JWT whose `nonce` is the verifier's nonce and whose `aud` is the verifier's identifier.

A W3C Verifiable Presentation secured by its holder's Data Integrity proof, binding the verifier's nonce and audience as the proof's `challenge` and `domain` (preferred, OID4VP §14.1.2) or as the presentation's own signed `nonce` and `domain`; where both are stated they agree.

Presentation.description: One presentation; the consumer selects the verification path from the value's type, so a new credential format needs no new member here.

schema.description: Holder to verifier: an OID4VP vp_token keyed by credential query id, each value an array of selectively-disclosed, holder-bound presentations. Replies on the query thread.

vp_token.description: The OID4VP `vp_token`. Canonically the DCQL response object of OID4VP 1.0 §8.1: keyed by credential query `id`, each value an array of one or more presentations. A bare SD-JWT-VC presentation string, the shape credential-exchange/present/0.1 producers send, is still accepted for compatibility. snake_case is OID4VP's own name for this field.

oneOf.description: Compatibility: a single SD-JWT-VC presentation, answering the query's only credential query. A producer MUST NOT send this shape; a consumer SHOULD accept it.

schema.title: Credential Exchange Present — payload
